title: citry-events/1 call envelope
description: The strict request envelope a client sends to a citry-events/1 server.

requestId.description: Client-created correlation ID, echoed verbatim in the result envelope.

capabilities.description: Exactly the swaps and actions this client can apply. An absent object or key uses the v1 baseline.

componentClassId.description: The server-assigned ID of the component class that owns the handler.

callerRenderId.description: The render ID of the component instance that sent the call. Omitted for calls with no rendered caller.

args.description: Open application data passed to the handler.

stateToken.description: The caller's opaque signed state token. Omitted for stateless calls.

stateUpdates.description: Open application data containing writable State updates applied before the handler runs.

sendSequence.description: The increasing send counter for the browser's stable record of this caller. The result echoes it so the browser can discard older responses.
